title: 2024 Bowman #11 Kyle Harrison San Francisco Giants Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2024 Bowman sports trading card features Kyle Harrison, a rookie player for the San Francisco Giants in Major League Baseball (MLB). The card bears the card number 11 and is part of the 2024 Bowman set manufactured by Bowman. It is a great addition to any baseball fan's collection, especially those who love collecting rookie cards.

This card is not autographed and belongs to the category of sports trading card singles. Its title is "2024 Bowman Kyle Harrison RC #11 San Francisco Giants". This card is perfect for those who want to complete their collection or those who are fans of Kyle Harrison and the San Francisco Giants.
